title: Assessing Adequacy of Parking Lots for Delivery Trucks in Multi-storey Carparks in Public Housing Estates or Town Centres
what_it_is: Assessing Adequacy of Parking Lots for Delivery Trucks in Multi-storey Carparks in Public Housing Estates or Town Centres

sections.label: HDB loading and unloading bays
sections.summary: Loading and unloading bays near HDB blocks have no height limits, and their number may be adjusted locally based on feedback.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To facilitate loading and unloading activities, the bays are located near HDB blocks and do not have height limits.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Delivery drivers can make use of these bays for loading and unloading activities.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The number of loading and unloading bays may be adjusted at the local level based on feedback from commercial tenants and users of these bays.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: HDB exercises flexibility allowing delivery drivers, whether they are alone or even with some accompanying colleagues, time to do their deliveries.
